# Backend Instructions (Python API)

Applies to backend code (API, database, business logic).

## Guidelines
- Keep API endpoints simple and predictable
- Use clear and consistent data models
- Avoid overcomplicated database design
- Error and log messages must not contain sensitive data.
- Keep changes local and minimal.
